Rank of H2(K2)->H2(K3) equals 1 by explicitly combining all 39 kernel generators with rank-326 boundaries (rank becomes 327). The maximal-distance complement is a perfect 12-edge matching, proving K5 homeomorphic to S11; K6 is a full simplex. Proof does not claim integral or all-n consequences.

value.rationale: Kendall tau distance and the permutahedron are canonical ranking and polyhedral metrics; a complete finite persistence barcode in high degrees is a motivated unknown exact invariant, not an arbitrary slice. The result reveals a persistent degree-two generator, simultaneous degree-four and degree-five homology at scale four, and a sphere at the penultimate scale. Its two self-contained full exact computations form a useful reproducibility benchmark without promising a general-n theorem.
